bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Emerge Community Development.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Emerge Community Development to support and reinforce critical workforce at the Emerge Career and Technical Center, Cedar Riverside Opportunity Center, and Emerge Second Chance programs in the city of Minneapolis.
additions: $600,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $600,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Emerge Community Development to support and reinforce critical workforce at the Emerge Career and Technical Center, Cedar Riverside Opportunity Center, and Emerge Second Chance programs in the city of Minneapolis.
